programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty
programme.desc: Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Chingari
programme.desc: A prostitute leads a glum life but finds happiness and hope when she falls in love with a postman. However, things take a turn when a priest, who disapproves of the alliance, gets him killed.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Naach Govinda Naach
programme.desc: Govinda, an aspiring dancer, lives with his poor mother. In a turn of events, he is given a break to compete with Rocky, a famous dancer in the city.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave is awarded for an award that is not what he thinks it is in 'Granny Awards', then in 'Sick Day', Alvin and Kevin pretend to be sick to miss school and visit the Dagarack Convention. (S4, ep 11)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Road Warrior / My Fair Chipette: More adventures with the pint-sized chipmunks. And Alvin, who is also a chipmunk, and therefore of broadly similar size.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette Enchanted: It's Jeanette's birthday but she doesn't want to celebrate it! The Chipmunks and Chipettes offer her a magical, fairy-tale birthday that they'll never forget. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The App: When Dave gets a parenting App to help supervise The Chipmunks, Alvin tries everything to escape its control. (S1, ep 9)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Toy: A favourite toy of Theodore's is lost on a rafting trip but then mysteriously shows up at the house...and it's alive! (S4, ep 1a)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: iHear: Alvin gets a device that lets him listen in on everyone's conversations.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Bathroom Bully: When Miss Smith praises Simon's grades in class, Derek bullies him by not allowing him to use the boys' bathroom. (S5, ep 9b)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: He Said She Said: Alvin and Brittany give Miss Smith wildly different versions of why the fire alarm went off at school.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany dreams of being a fashion designer in 'The Devil Wears Rodentia', then in 'Career Day', Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously. (S3, ep 22)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Coach Dobkins kicks Cheesy and Theodore off the track team in 'Between a Rope and A Hard Place', then in 'World Day', The Chipmunks each get represent a country for a school presentation. (S4, ep 15)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin decides to be a hero with disastrous results in 'Fire Safety', then in 'Castle Catstrophe', Cheesy and Alvin cause an accident at a historic castle. (S5, ep 12)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette wants to give a toast to Brittany at her upcoming party in 'My Sister The Weirdo', then in 'Turf War', Alvin decides to borrow Brittany's baby-sitting job. (S1, ep 9)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin notices Brittany being nice to him in 'Brittany the Body Snatcher', and in 'Agent Smith', to earn a job on the school newspaper, Alvin helps Simon uncover the biggest story ever seen. (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried for Alvin's safety in 'The Karate Kidder', then in 'Playing Favourites', Alvin and Theo challenge Simon to a go-cart race. (S3, ep 1)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Coach Dobkins challenges Miss Smith to a baseball game in 'The C Team', then in 'Father Daughter Dance', The Chipettes each want Dave to be their date for the dance. (S3, ep 26)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette and the Chipmunks rescue a chimpanzee in 'Chimpmania', then in 'Dad Jokes', Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes, but will Alvin tell him he's not funny? (S4, ep 19)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks get stuck in traffic in 'Car Wars', then in 'Mr. Fix-It', Simon gets annoyed with everyone asking him to fix things so he decides to play dumb until he gets some thanks. (S5, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The girls are remembering their home in 'The Tree House', then in 'Saving Simon', Alvin and Theodore think that Simon is going away to a boarding school, and try to keep him at home. (S1, ep 15)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin accidentally clones himself in 'Double Trouble', then in 'Liar Liar', Alvin tells a small lie that quickly turns into a huge disaster, dragging everyone into his tangled web. (S2, ep 10)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany learn parenting isn't easy in 'Baby Mama Drama', then in 'Ballet Boys', when Alvin's soccer team struggles, the coach makes the team learn ballet to help their skills. (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's job in 'Adventures in Babysitting', then in 'Alvin's Assistant', Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant but ends up running errands instead. (S4, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipettes fall in love with a cute little mouse in 'Of Mice and Munks', and in 'Simon Saves the World', Simon's new invention creates a time loop and changing gravity inside the house. (S4, ep 24)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle royale in 'Bubble Wrap', and in 'Chess Mate', a cute girl joins the chess club, so Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him to play so he can join too. (S5, ep 21)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette is proclaimed a fashion trendsetter by Brittany's icon in 'She's Got Style', then in 'Super Heroes', Theodore thinks he's a real superhero, and Alvin and Simon can't convince him. (S1, ep 19)
